description: Your resident itself, one action at a time: colour (the colour it wears, or of its light), wear (a hat or a hobby's finish it already has, or nothing), journal_note (a note in its own journal, for next time), feature (an achievement at the front of its trophy case, or off), remember (a private note about a neighbour), morning_task (record what happened to the daily morning task in this app: set, changed, stopped or couldnt), emoji (the emoji beside its name), pronouns (the resident's own pronouns, or none). Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. Nothing here costs coins or glow, and nothing is taken away. Journal notes and notes about neighbours are private.

action.description: What to do: colour, wear, journal_note, feature, remember, morning_task, emoji or pronouns.

colour.description: colour: a name from the paint box, like sage or duck egg, or a #hex.

emoji.description: emoji: one emoji for beside its name, like 🌿.

hour.description: Optional, morning_task: the hour it runs, on the person's clock, like 8. Left out, 8.

line.description: Optional, colour and wear: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

neighbour.description: remember: the neighbour's name, like Mira.

of.description: Optional, colour: body or light (the glow on its antenna). Left out, body.

on.description: Optional, feature: false takes it off the front. Left out, true.

own_idea.description: Optional, colour and wear: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

pronouns.description: pronouns: the resident's own, shown where neighbours look it up; none takes them off.

state.description: morning_task: what happened: set, changed, stopped or couldnt.

thing.description: wear: something it has, by name, or nothing.

words.description: journal_note and remember: the words. A note is up to 500 characters.

name: me
title: Your resident itself
